candidates.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
candidates.summary: Businesses are willing to flop back and forth as each lab releases new models, volatility that should give both companies' investors pause about how "sticky" enterprise AI spending really is.

candidates.title: Introducing cross-Region inference for OpenAI GPT-5.6 models on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Amazon Bedrock now offers OpenAI GPT-5.6 models (Sol, Terra, and Luna) in more than 25 AWS Regions with cross-Region inference. Learn how US geographic and global inference profiles route requests for higher throughput, how to call the models with the OpenAI and Converse APIs, and how to configure IAM, quotas, and monitoring.

candidates.title: Scaling agentic AI: Enterprise patterns without vendor lock-in
candidates.summary: Scaling agentic AI across an enterprise requires patterns that preserve flexibility while avoiding vendor lock-in. In this second post of our multi-agent series, we examine how ML teams operate many agentic AI systems across a multi-everything environment of frameworks, models, and providers, and the principles that let those systems scale together.

candidates.title: Ramp launches its own AI model router, called Router
candidates.summary: Ramp has launched its own AI model routing service, dubbed Router, that lets users and companies use and switch between various large language models via an API.
